#286 · Mushroom Pokémon

Breloom

Grass Fighting

Hoenn · Generation 3

Breloom is a Grass/Fighting-type Mushroom Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 1.2 m tall and weighs 39.2 kg. It evolves from Shroomish. Its highest base stat is Attack (130), with a base stat total of 460.
